title: Public Weighs In on Western Oaks Annexation
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened to hold a public hearing regarding the proposed annexation of the Village at Western Oaks neighborhood.
*   City officials and department heads provided information on the annexation process and presented detailed service plans for the area.
*   Eight citizens signed up to speak during the public hearing, offering their perspectives on the potential annexation.
*   The public hearing for the Village at Western Oaks annexation was officially closed following a unanimous vote by the elected body.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
NOVEMBER 18,1997-6:30 P.M.
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order, noting the absence of Councilmembers Lewis and
Spelman.
Councilmember Spelman arrived at 6:41 p.m.
Public hearing on the annexation of Village at Western Oaks.
Assistant City Manager Toby Futrell presented areas of information on the annexation
issues and where these could be located.
Several department directors and assistant directors presented the different areas of the
service plan.
8 Citizens signed appearance cards (on file in City Clerk's Office) Close the public
hearing on Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's motion, Councilmember Slusher's second, 6-0 vote,
Councilmember Lewis absent.
ADJOURNED at 7:08 p.m. on Councilmember Spelman's motion, Mayor Pro Tern Garcia's second,
6-0 vote, Councilmember Lewis absent.
Approved on this the 18th day of December, 1998 on Councilmember Goodman's motion,
Councilmember Slusher's second, 6-0 vote, Mayor Watson absent.
